limits: Operation labels are resource-domain RETURNED STATES, not physical side-effect counts or actual MCP invocation counts. Successful act tasks include skip/replay products.
Eight or more method failures may coexist with a complete, consistent, normally closed cohort. No failure row is replaced or relabeled success.
Reported token totals include known usage only; missing usage and pre-request budget rejection are separate from recorded provider failures.
Outer OS exit is checked against a root-observed tool receipt, independently from supervisor.finished claims.
No raw model context/content, approval tokens, task args/products, customer intents, HTTP bodies or transport messages are copied.
No network, Docker, SQLite, broker, model, task, repair or original-output write is performed. Final H00 is separate from45 recovery denominator.
Source/proof/config files are hashed; large model binaries are not rehashed here. No global broker/ACL or live resource claim.

summary.stderr_scope: Only the four specified cleanup event classes are counted above; other stderr remains in its original hashed file. This is not a zero-all-warnings claim.
summary.route_scope: Route is an allowed mutable runtime file; any byte difference needs the separate resource postcheck and root review, not a rewrite by this file reviewer.

operation_count_scope: Resource-domain returned states, including idempotent skips; not physical side effects or MCP call counts.
